# anyways.

> South African performance marketing agency for DTC and lead-gen brands. We find what's broken in your marketing, tell you straight, and fix it, week after week.

## Services
- Paid social: Meta, Instagram and TikTok campaigns with new angles tested weekly.
- Search & shopping: Google Search, Performance Max and YouTube, with clean shopping feeds, cutting wasted spend first.
- Funnels & landing pages: pages, forms and flows, A/B tested.
- AI creative studio: AI-made statics, UGC-style ads and short-form video every week.
- Email & SMS: Klaviyo lifecycle flows and campaigns.
- Shopify stores: full Shopify store builds and CRO.

## How we work
- Say it: a 24-hour audit that says what's broken.
- Pivot: a plan ranked by impact, live the same week.
- Fix: weekly tests and reports until the number moves.
